instruction: Add both of these open webpages to my bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires bookmarking both open tabs to the bookmark bar. Uses the existing is_expected_bookmarks metric with bookmark_bar_websites_urls type to verify both URLs are in the bookmark bar. Similar difficulty to original (bookmarking 2 pages instead of 1).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements in the instruction
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk and can be read
Getter (get_bookmarks) can successfully extract bookmark state from Chrome's Bookmarks file
Metric (is_expected_bookmarks) correctly checks if both expected URLs are present in bookmark bar using subset verification
Expected values are correct - the two URLs match the URLs opened in the config
Complete coverage - evaluator checks that BOTH URLs are bookmarked, not just one
Logic will work correctly at runtime - bookmarks are persisted, getter can read file, metric performs correct comparison
